screen: G5 exact-coordinate collision feature with fixed half-weight attenuation for place stacks overlapping large commercial footprints; descriptive-only

method.outcome: Frozen S1 orthogonalized establishment/facility disagreement cross-fit residual; no labels or refit.
method.G5_definition: Exact source lon/lat coordinate stack, at least five distinct stripped/casefolded nonempty primary names, stacked place count in tract divided by all eligible assigned place count.
method.soft_definition: G5_soft = G5_unfiltered - 0.5 * G5_overlapping_large_footprints. The overlap component is qualifying-stack POI count inside a qualifying footprint divided by all eligible assigned POI count; its denominator is unchanged. A stack is attenuated as a whole because its members share its exact coordinate.
method.footprint_rule: Reuse the hard-filter screen's exact provided-only OSM/Esri-exclusive building source guard, whole-word commercial/industrial/warehouse/retail/shopping/mall class tokens, EPSG:5070 area >=5000 m2, and covered_by point predicate; no buffers or tuning.
method.fit: One-term OLS correction to frozen S1 residual; leave-one-five-digit-county-out separately within each official region; training-only feature mean and population SD; zero SD scale=1.
method.bootstrap: 2000 paired county-block resamples within region, same seed and held-county SSE blocks as G5 hard-filter screen.
method.effective_stack_retention: (all qualifying stacks - 0.5 * overlapping qualifying stacks) / all qualifying stacks; each overlapping stack retained at half weight, not deleted.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature residual association only; not target accuracy, causality, or estimator-promotion evidence.

paired_county_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-out county SSE blocks sampled with replacement within each official region
